blocks.raw:
• **Utility meter**: Primary revenue-grade meter from Meralco; records kWh and kW demand
  • **Data collector/concentrator**: Aggregates sub-meter and sensor readings; communicates via GPRS or fiber to utility backend
  • **Building-side gateway**: Receives AMI signals; interfaces with Building Energy Management System (BEMS)
  • **Communications protocol**: Meralco uses IEC 62056-21 (DLMS/COSEM) for meter data exchange; buildings may use Modbus TCP or BACnet/IP internally

blocks.raw:
<LeartBox severity="info">
**Energy anomalies detected by BEMS typically include:**
- Demand spikes >15% above rolling 7-day baseline (suggests unscheduled equipment activation or fault)
- Power factor <0.90 at billing interval (indicates excessive reactive load; penalties apply under Meralco contracts)
- Temperature setpoint drift >2°C from schedule (suggests thermostat malfunction)
- Lighting consumption during unoccupied periods (vacancy sensors or occupancy sensors malfunctioning)
</LeartBox>
